learning_plane: priors on: <meshloop>/benches/learning-plane/results/priors-lp-4-warmup.json (sha256 b4ee3e2901b6aeee20eca59cd0a55474a4e9919e5368d1bc9a87ef559727066c) promoted with `priors accept --as claude-coordinator` into every fresh store before its run
protocol: Fixed automated protocol, no human in the loop: review-plan --accept of a one-node plan with the task's planned tier, run, then resume --retry while the node is Failed and attempts remain (up to max_retries), accept --task 1 only when Meshloop's own checks passed (node AwaitingReview), resume, integrate --into main --accept-integrate; success is the exit code of the task's hidden tests run on main after integration. The plan is never adjusted or declined, so Adjust/Decline = 0 by protocol, not by measurement of a human.
state_carried: Each task x repetition runs in a new disposable Git repository with a new Meshloop store, so routing_feedback, quota_state, attempts and events start empty for every task (checked and recorded per run as routing_feedback_before). Nothing Meshloop stores carries across tasks or repetitions. Not controlled: vendor-side state outside the repository (harness CLI login, user-level config and instruction files, vendor caches and account quota windows).

overall.adjust_decline_note: 0 by protocol (fixed automated acceptance), not a human measurement
